"""Pixel based locked-camera reconstruction and analytic occlusion animation.
Only the supplied RGB photograph is used as source material.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import math
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H=3840,2160
cv2.setNumThreads(4)

def smooth(x):
    x=np.clip(x,0.,1.)
    return x*x*(3-2*x)

def poly(points):
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
    cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.round(points).astype(np.int32)],255,lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    return m

def blend(dst,rgb,alpha):
    a=alpha.astype(np.float32)[...,None]
    if a.max()>1.01:a/=255.
    return np.clip(dst.astype(np.float32)*(1-a)+rgb.astype(np.float32)*a,0,255).astype(np.uint8)

def prepare(im):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(438)
    # Front face and small folded support visible along its left side.
    corners=np.float32([[1705,758],[2747,703],[2884,1630],[1852,1917]])
    card=poly(corners)
    side=poly([[1705,758],[1815,1633],[1530,1635]])
    cm=np.maximum(card,side)
    # Isolate the actual gripper and rod from the neutral wall numerically.
    outline=[[1734,0],[1831,0],[1819,249],[1831,270],[1824,598],
             [1843,731],[1839,748],[1752,760],[1702,815],[1703,875],
             [1736,906],[1667,932],[1621,971],[1586,1024],[1570,1091],
             [1568,1139],[1594,1197],[1603,1258],[1592,1317],
             [1580,1358],[1558,1377],[1528,1374],[1485,1341],[1478,1260],
             [1476,1192],[1462,1111],[1468,1035],[1491,958],[1530,892],
             [1617,789],[1658,714],[1683,645],[1692,559],[1709,275],[1726,250]]
    pm=poly(outline)
    r,g,b=im.astype(np.int16).transpose(2,0,1)
    yy=np.arange(H)[:,None]
    obj=((r<108)&((r-g<12)|(g-b<5)))|(b-r>19)
    obj|=(yy<250)&(r<152)
    tm=(pm.astype(float)*obj).astype(np.uint8)
    tm=cv2.morphologyEx(tm,cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
    tm=gaussian_filter(tm.astype(np.float32),.65)
    # Missing scene pixels are synthesized from the same photograph's wall and
    # wood samples. The untouched photograph remains bit-for-bit static.
    Y,X=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
    edge=np.interp(np.arange(W),[0,1400,2200,2840,3840],
                   [1450,1335,1257,1188,1580])[None,:]
    wall_left=im[:,1400].astype(float)
    wall_right=im[:,2990].astype(float)
    # Both samples are wall above the table; continue their smooth light falloff.
    for y in range(1180,H):
        wall_right[y]=wall_right[1179]+np.array([-0.045,-0.045,-0.045])*(y-1179)
    for y in range(1320,H):
        wall_left[y]=wall_left[1319]+np.array([-0.028,-0.028,-0.028])*(y-1319)
    xx=np.clip((np.arange(W)-1400)/1590,0,1)[None,:,None]
    wall=wall_left[:,None,:]*(1-xx)+wall_right[:,None,:]*xx
    noise=rng.normal(0,.46,(H,W)).astype(np.float32)
    wall+=noise[...,None]
    sx=(1050+np.mod((X-1400)*.35,320)).astype(np.float32)
    sy=np.clip((Y+1400-edge).astype(np.float32),0,H-1)
    wood=cv2.remap(im,sx,sy,cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    # Under the original screen the wood is warm, softly shaded and finely grained.
    correction=np.clip((X-1700)/1600,0,1)
    wood=np.clip(wood.astype(float)+correction[...,None]*np.array([5,2,0]),0,255)
    tablemix=smooth((Y-edge)/7)[...,None]
    clean=wall*(1-tablemix)+wood*tablemix
    clean=np.clip(clean,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    # Reconstruct only the occluded part of the black rotating platform.
    top=poly([[1710,1609],[2210,1553],[2727,1668],[2747,1710],
              [2730,1888],[2220,1950],[1705,1907],[1705,1655]])
    toptex=np.empty_like(im)
    lum=44-.021*(Y-1730)+.6*noise
    toptex[:]=np.clip(lum[...,None]+np.array([1,-1,0]),0,255)
    clean=blend(clean,toptex,top)
    # Front face and shadow use original pixels when already visible.
    front=poly([[1705,1882],[2740,1840],[2722,1937],[2682,2030],
                [2520,2098],[2010,2125],[1800,2035],[1705,1930]])
    flum=11+3*np.sin((X-1700)/300)+noise*.5
    ft=np.clip(flum[...,None]+np.array([1,0,-2]),0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    clean=blend(clean,ft,front)
    # Remove only the subjects, preserving all other pixels of the locked shot.
    remove=np.maximum(cm,tm.astype(np.uint8))
    remove=cv2.dilate(remove,np.ones((5,5),np.uint8))
    remove=gaussian_filter(remove.astype(float),1.4)
    base=blend(im,clean,remove)
    # Crop sprites to keep every per-frame warp small.
    tx0,ty0,tx1,ty1=1435,0,2085,1390
    trgb=im[ty0:ty1,tx0:tx1].copy()
    ta=tm[ty0:ty1,tx0:tx1].copy()
    # The matching jaw was initially behind the cardstock. Mirror only the
    # curved lower jaw, not the asymmetric main rod or handle.
    lower=tm.copy();lower[:750]=0
    mirror=cv2.warpAffine(lower,np.float32([[-1,0,3530],[0,1,0]]),(W,H))
    mrgb=cv2.warpAffine(im,np.float32([[-1,0,3530],[0,1,0]]),(W,H))
    trgb=blend(trgb,mrgb[:1390,1435:2085],mirror[:1390,1435:2085])
    ta=np.maximum(ta,mirror[:1390,1435:2085])
    # Camera calibration from the screen's two vanishing directions.
    old=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(np.float32([[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]]),corners)
    K=np.array([[1778.5,0,1920],[0,1778.5,1080],[0,0,1.]])
    A=np.linalg.inv(K)@old
    u,v,o=A[:,0],A[:,1],A[:,2]
    un=u/np.linalg.norm(u);vn=v/np.linalg.norm(v);normal=np.cross(un,vn)
    center=o+.5*u+v
    return base,cm,card,side,(trgb,ta,tx0),old,K,u,v,un,normal,center

def tennis_ball():
    # Analytic spherical lighting, fine felt fibres and two curved ivory seams.
    R=156;size=2*R+12
    y,x=np.mgrid[:size,:size].astype(np.float32)
    x=(x-(size-1)/2)/R;y=(y-(size-1)/2)/R
    d=x*x+y*y;z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-d))
    alpha=np.clip((1-np.sqrt(d))*R+1,0,1)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2717)
    n=rng.normal(0,1,(size,size)).astype(np.float32)
    fibre=gaussian_filter(n,.42)*2.2+gaussian_filter(n,1.1)*1.0
    light=np.clip(-.40*x-.52*y+.73*z,0,1)
    shading=.46+.53*light
    rgb=shading[...,None]*np.array([229,109,27])[None,None,:]
    rgb+=fibre[...,None]*np.array([1.5,1.0,.65])
    rgb+=(np.maximum(0,z)**12*2)[...,None]
    # Two winding lines on the sphere, with a recessed dark edge.
    curve=.53-.34*np.cos((y+.05)*2.4)
    seam=np.minimum(abs(x-curve),abs(x+curve))
    aa=np.clip((.035-seam)*R,0,1)*alpha
    recess=np.clip((.053-seam)*R,0,1)*alpha
    rgb=rgb*(1-.15*recess[...,None])
    cream=shading[...,None]*np.array([237,214,166])
    rgb=rgb*(1-aa[...,None])+cream*aa[...,None]
    rgb=np.clip(rgb,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    return rgb,alpha

def stamp(frame,rgb,a,cx,cy):
    h,w=a.shape
    x=int(round(cx-w/2));y=int(round(cy-h/2))
    x0=max(x,0);y0=max(y,0);x1=min(x+w,W);y1=min(y+h,H)
    if x1>x0 and y1>y0:
        frame[y0:y1,x0:x1]=blend(frame[y0:y1,x0:x1],rgb[y0-y:y1-y,x0-x:x1-x],a[y0-y:y1-y,x0-x:x1-x])

def run():
    src=np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
    base,cm,face,side,sprite,old,K,u,v,un,n,c=prepare(src)
    trgb,ta,tx=sprite
    ballrgb,balla=tennis_ball()
    # Premultiply all warped sprites to eliminate wall-coloured edge fringes.
    cp=src.astype(np.float32)*(cm[...,None]/255.)
    cbox=(1450,690,2910,1940);x0,y0,x1,y1=cbox
    cs=cp[y0:y1,x0:x1];ca=cm[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)/255
    tp=trgb.astype(np.float32)*(ta[...,None]/255.)
    tma=ta.astype(np.float32)/255.
    invold=np.linalg.inv(old)
    frames=np.empty((120,H,W,3),np.uint8)
    frames[0]=src
    for i in range(1,120):
        t=i/24.
        frame=base.copy()
        # Rotation clockwise as seen looking down on the table. The vertical
        # axis is stationary; perspective changes continuously with rotation.
        angle=np.deg2rad(33.5*smooth(t/5.0))
        uu=np.linalg.norm(u)*(un*np.cos(angle)+n*np.sin(angle))
        pts=np.array([c-.5*uu-v,c+.5*uu-v,c+.5*uu,c-.5*uu])
        hp=pts@K.T;newq=(hp[:,:2]/hp[:,2:]).astype(np.float32)
        new=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(np.float32([[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]]),newq)
        matrix=new@invold
        # Bring the closed gripper behind the screen, lift, hold, lower, release.
        dx=460*smooth(t/.62)
        lift=smooth((t-.45)/.96)
        lower=smooth((t-1.82)/1.48)
        dy=-785*lift+1010*lower
        if t>3.5:dy=225-1660*smooth((t-3.5)/1.22)
        narrow=1-.28*smooth((t-.35)/.55)
        # The ball is hidden until the jaws are behind the screen, then it is
        # exposed by the lift and occluded naturally on the downward stroke.
        if t>.40:
            bx=1765+dx;by=1250-785*lift+1010*lower
            if t>=3.3:by=1475
            stamp(frame,ballrgb,balla,bx,by)
        m=np.float32([[narrow,0,tx*narrow+1765*(1-narrow)+dx],
                      [0,1,dy]])
        wr=cv2.warpAffine(tp,m,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        wa=cv2.warpAffine(tma,m,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        frame=np.clip(frame.astype(np.float32)*(1-wa[...,None])+wr,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
        # Depth order: gripper and ball behind both faces of the rotating card.
        mat=matrix@np.array([[1,0,x0],[0,1,y0],[0,0,1.]])
        cr=cv2.warpPerspective(cs,mat,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        am=cv2.warpPerspective(ca,mat,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        # Small lighting response of the paper as its normal turns.
        shade=1-.042*np.sin(angle)
        cr*=shade
        frame=np.clip(frame.astype(np.float32)*(1-am[...,None])+cr,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
        # The first few displaced pixels blend into the exact original image;
        # this avoids any instantaneous change due to newly unoccluded pixels.
        if t<.12:
            frame=blend(src,frame,np.full((H,W),smooth(t/.12),np.float32))
        frames[i]=frame
        if i%12==0:print(f'rendered {i}/119',flush=True)
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0],src)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    print('Saved 120 native RGB frames and viewer.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':run()

    wall=wall_left[:,None,:]*(1-xx)+wall_right[:,None,:]*xx
    noise=rng.normal(0,.46,(H,W)).astype(np.float32)
    wall+=noise[...,None]
    sx=np.clip((1080+(X-1450)*.72).astype(np.float32),50,2700)
    sy=np.clip((Y+1380-edge).astype(np.float32),0,H-1)
    wood=cv2.remap(im,sx,sy,cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    # Under the original screen the wood is warm, softly shaded and finely grained.
    correction=np.clip((X-1700)/1600,0,1)
    wood=np.clip(wood.astype(float)+correction[...,None]*np.array([5,2,0]),0,255)
    tablemix=smooth((Y-edge)/7)[...,None]
    clean=wall*(1-tablemix)+wood*tablemix
    clean=np.clip(clean,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    # Reconstruct only the occluded part of the black rotating platform.
    top=poly([[1710,1609],[2210,1553],[2727,1668],[2747,1710],
              [2730,1888],[2220,1950],[1705,1907],[1705,1655]])

    tx0,ty0,tx1,ty1=1435,0,2085,1390

    A=np.linalg.inv(K)@old

def tennis_ball():
    # Analytic spherical lighting, fine felt fibres and two curved ivory seams.
    R=156;size=2*R+12
    y,x=np.mgrid[:size,:size].astype(np.float32)
    x=(x-(size-1)/2)/R;y=(y-(size-1)/2)/R
    d=x*x+y*y;z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-d))
    alpha=np.clip((1-np.sqrt(d))*R+1,0,1)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2717)
    n=rng.normal(0,1,(size,size)).astype(np.float32)
    fibre=gaussian_filter(n,.42)*2.2+gaussian_filter(n,1.1)*1.0
    light=np.clip(-.40*x-.52*y+.73*z,0,1)
    shading=.46+.53*light
    rgb=shading[...,None]*np.array([229,109,27])[None,None,:]
    rgb+=fibre[...,None]*np.array([1.5,1.0,.65])
    rgb+=(np.maximum(0,z)**12*2)[...,None]
    # Two winding lines on the sphere, with a recessed dark edge.
    curve=.53-.34*np.cos((y+.05)*2.4)
    seam=np.minimum(abs(x-curve),abs(x+curve))
    aa=np.clip((.035-seam)*R,0,1)*alpha
    recess=np.clip((.053-seam)*R,0,1)*alpha
    rgb=rgb*(1-.15*recess[...,None])
    cream=shading[...,None]*np.array([237,214,166])
    rgb=rgb*(1-aa[...,None])+cream*aa[...,None]
    rgb=np.clip(rgb,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    return rgb,alpha

def stamp(frame,rgb,a,cx,cy):
    h,w=a.shape
    x=int(round(cx-w/2));y=int(round(cy-h/2))
    x0=max(x,0);y0=max(y,0);x1=min(x+w,W);y1=min(y+h,H)
    if x1>x0 and y1>y0:
        frame[y0:y1,x0:x1]=blend(frame[y0:y1,x0:x1],rgb[y0-y:y1-y,x0-x:x1-x],a[y0-y:y1-y,x0-x:x1-x])

def run():
    src=np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
    base,cm,face,side,sprite,old,K,u,v,un,n,c=prepare(src)
    trgb,ta,tx=sprite
    ballrgb,balla=tennis_ball()
    # Premultiply all warped sprites to eliminate wall-coloured edge fringes.
    cp=src.astype(np.float32)*(cm[...,None]/255.)
    cbox=(1450,690,2910,1940);x0,y0,x1,y1=cbox
    cs=cp[y0:y1,x0:x1];ca=cm[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)/255
    tp=trgb.astype(np.float32)*(ta[...,None]/255.)
    tma=ta.astype(np.float32)/255.
    invold=np.linalg.inv(old)
    frames=np.empty((120,H,W,3),np.uint8)
    frames[0]=src
    for i in range(1,120):
        t=i/24.
        frame=base.copy()
        # Rotation clockwise as seen looking down on the table. The vertical
        # axis is stationary; perspective changes continuously with rotation.
        angle=np.deg2rad(33.5*smooth(t/5.0))
        uu=np.linalg.norm(u)*(un*np.cos(angle)+n*np.sin(angle))
        pts=np.array([c-.5*uu-v,c+.5*uu-v,c+.5*uu,c-.5*uu])
        hp=pts@K.T;newq=(hp[:,:2]/hp[:,2:]).astype(np.float32)
        new=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(np.float32([[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]]),newq)
        matrix=new@invold
        # Bring the closed gripper behind the screen, lift, hold, lower, release.
        dx=460*smooth(t/.62)
        lift=smooth((t-.45)/.96)
        lower=smooth((t-1.82)/1.48)
        dy=-785*lift+1010*lower
        if t>3.5:dy=225-1660*smooth((t-3.5)/1.22)
        narrow=1-.28*smooth((t-.35)/.55)
        # The ball is hidden until the jaws are behind the screen, then it is
        # exposed by the lift and occluded naturally on the downward stroke.
        if t>.40:
            bx=1765+dx;by=1250-785*lift+1010*lower
            if t>=3.3:by=1475
            stamp(frame,ballrgb,balla,bx,by)
        m=np.float32([[narrow,0,tx*narrow+1765*(1-narrow)+dx],
                      [0,1,dy]])
        wr=cv2.warpAffine(tp,m,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        wa=cv2.warpAffine(tma,m,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        frame=np.clip(frame.astype(np.float32)*(1-wa[...,None])+wr,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
        # Depth order: gripper and ball behind both faces of the rotating card.
        mat=matrix@np.array([[1,0,x0],[0,1,y0],[0,0,1.]])
        cr=cv2.warpPerspective(cs,mat,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        am=cv2.warpPerspective(ca,mat,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        # Small lighting response of the paper as its normal turns.
        shade=1-.042*np.sin(angle)
        cr*=shade
        frame=np.clip(frame.astype(np.float32)*(1-am[...,None])+cr,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
        # The first few displaced pixels blend into the exact original image;
        # this avoids any instantaneous change due to newly unoccluded pixels.
        if t<.12:
            frame=blend(src,frame,np.full((H,W),smooth(t/.12),np.float32))
        frames[i]=frame
        if i%12==0:print(f'rendered {i}/119',flush=True)
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0],src)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    print('Saved 120 native RGB frames and viewer.',flush=True)
